provenance.method: Steam developer/publisher listing checked on 2026-09-02. Governed wording records the developer-stated no-timer/no-punishment structure, one-hand mouse play and pick-up/put-down design without inferring therapeutic benefit.

name: The Shape of Things
description: A single-player 3D object puzzle game whose developer describes no timers, no punishment system, own-pace progress, one-hand mouse play and easy pick-up/put-down sessions.
intended_use: Inspect for short own-pace puzzle sessions, low failure consequences or comparatively simple mouse input.
audience_or_context: General-audience puzzle players browsing by pressure, interruption and input characteristics rather than diagnosis.
limitations: Rotating, panning and scaling 3D objects can still create visuospatial, motion or motor-access demands.
One-hand mouse play is not the same as comprehensive accessibility or alternative-input support.
The game's soothing presentation language is promotional description, not evidence of a universal emotional effect.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial PC game distributed through Steam; price and platform requirements can change.
conflicts_of_interest: The Steam listing is developer/publisher-supplied commercial information; ND Oracle uses only bounded feature statements for discovery.
